channel.title: Digital Assets in 2026: The Infrastructure Transition Banks Cannot Delay
channel.description: Digital assets are no longer an innovation bet. They are a settlement, custody, and balance-sheet architecture question. The strategic task for banks is infrastructure design under structural uncertainty.

item.title: Digital Assets in 2026: The Infrastructure Transition Banks Cannot Delay
item.description: Digital assets are a settlement, custody, and balance-sheet architecture question. Stablecoins, tokenised deposits, and RWA tokenisation demand infrastructure design — not pilot proliferation.
